newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's CANTV says labor talks going smoothly.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's CANTV says labor talks going smoothly.

text.p: Venezuelan national telephone company CANTV, recently threatened by possible strike action, said negotiations with labor over 1997 and 1998 contracts were continuing smoothly.
"The talks are proceeding according to schedule and the company will present its latest offer to Fetratel on February 5," the company said.

Fetratel is an umbrella labor group that gathers the 29 unions employed by CANTV. One of these, the Telecommunications Union of Federal District and Miranda State, has said it will strike over what it claims are insufficient pay increases.
But on Tuesday Fetratel said the strikes threatened for this week would not take place, although it did not rule out the possibility of subsequent action.

Workers have asked for a 120 percent wage rise to compensate for 103 percent inflation in 1996. CANTV has so offered increases, including bonuses, of 34 percent for this year and 65 percent for the next.
